Nōdōtus (Nōdūt- ), i, m.,
I.a deity who presided over corn, and brought it as far as the knots in the stalk: praefecerunt ergo ... geniculis nodisque culmorum deum Nodutum, Aug. Civ. Dei, 4, 8; Arn. 4, 131.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
